title: Summoned Fargate host pulls ComputerTurnJobs with ChromiumActionExecutor
description:
Live ComputerWorker RunTask still starts sleep-infinity. The Chromium executor is kernel-only (0eef8f). The summoned host must boot, record browser readiness, and pull ComputerTurnJobs itself. Lambda must not run Chromium. ChatticusComputers desiredCount stays 0. Do not cdk deploy --all.

```gherkin
Feature: Host computer pull worker
  Scenario: ECS RunTask overrides the computer container to the host worker
    Given CHATTICUS_ECS_HOST_COMMAND is the computer host worker module
    When the ECS host starter starts a host for a claim
    Then RunTask overrides that container command
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Kernel and ThinTurn IAM for 4bca15: computer_host_worker, RunTask container override when CHATTICUS_ECS_HOST_COMMAND is set, imported Computers task role granted SQS consume and Dynamo. Development Lambda does not set HOST_COMMAND yet — live ECR image still CMD sleep infinity. Story stays open until the image is rebuilt and a live browser tool completes. desiredCount 0. No --all.
